title: The Role of Participatory Village Maps in Strengthening Public Participation Practice

contacts.name: M Th  Koelen
contacts.affiliation: Faculty of Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation

descriptions: The data was collected in January-March 2020. I attended the Musrenbang meeting and ask the participants to fill a questionnaire. After that, in other days, I interviewed several participants in an in-depth semi structure interview. The data was analyzed and then used for a publication at MDPI ISPRS International Journal of Geo-Information.
